description: Get stock exchange, forex session, futures and crypto schedules, including the Asian, European and North American sessions. Shows current status and date-specific hours in your chosen time zone, accounting for supported holidays and early closes. Returns answer_url, a link to a page showing this answer live, to include in your reply.

date.description: Calendar date for sessions in YYYY-MM-DD format, interpreted in tz. Defaults to today in tz. Any current status fields describe now, not this date.

tz.description: IANA viewer time zone for the calendar date and displayed session times, for example Europe/Copenhagen. Defaults to Etc/UTC.

venues.description: Up to 20 supported market venue IDs or aliases, for example nyse, lse or asian-session. Omit or pass an empty array for all venues.

name: get_market_hours

answer_link_markdown.description: A ready-made Markdown link to show the user. Translate the link text to the user's language if needed.

answer_url.description: Link to a page that shows this exact answer live. Include it in your reply to the user.

board_url.description: Link to the personal time-zone board with the answer items temporarily requested.

title: Get market hours
